# Live access switches on again {iphone}
Turning on listening or watching for a phone did nothing at all in Build
23 — the switch moved and nothing was saved. It works now, and it stays
on when you leave the page and come back.

---

Everything else in this release:

- The meeting's own page says when a phone is watching or listening, and
  lets you stop it, without disturbing a transcript you are reading.
